name: Laura Schneider
title: Technical Writer
summary: Technical writer with 6+ years of experience creating clear, user-centered documentation for SaaS, cloud, and developer-focused products. Strong background in documentation systems, content governance, and cross-functional collaboration with engineering, product, and support teams. Comfortable turning complex technical concepts into concise release notes, API guides, and help center content that improve adoption and reduce support load.

bullets: Owns documentation for a cloud security platform used by 12,000+ active users, reducing documentation-related support tickets by 28% within 12 months.
Built a Python-based content validation script to check broken links, outdated snippets, and terminology consistency across 900+ pages.
Partnered with 8 engineering squads to ship release notes, onboarding guides, and API references for biweekly releases.
Introduced a reusable template system in Confluence and Markdown that cut authoring time for standard articles by 35%.
Produced and maintained product manuals, knowledge base articles, and in-app help for a fintech platform serving SMEs across DACH markets.
Collaborated with QA and product owners to document 40+ workflow changes per quarter and keep content aligned with sprint deliveries.
Created structured API documentation and example payloads that improved developer self-service and reduced integration questions by 21%.
Managed versioned content in Git and GitLab, enabling faster reviews and a more reliable publishing workflow.
Wrote end-user guides, troubleshooting articles, and internal process documentation for enterprise software products.
Standardized style and terminology across 250+ articles, improving consistency and reducing editing cycles by 30%.
Supported product launches by coordinating documentation updates with release schedules and localization requirements.
Maintained documentation analytics dashboards to track page performance and identify content gaps.
Drafted user help articles and quick-start guides for mobile and web applications under the guidance of senior writers.
Assisted with screenshots, content audits, and terminology management for German and English documentation.
Helped migrate legacy content into a new help center structure, improving navigation and searchability.
Contributed to a small Python utility used to batch-process image assets and rename documentation files consistently.
